scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @aikayun/api dev" "pnpm --filter @aikayun/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @aikayun/api build && pnpm --filter @aikayun/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @aikayun/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @aikayun/web typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PRODUCTION_SERVER=true pnpm e2e && pnpm --filter @aikayun/web test:e2e:production-brand
